user.title: Pick a power strip
user.description: {count} Phicomm DC1 strip(s) have already dialled in to this host. Pick the one you want to add.

manual.title: Power strip details
manual.description: The MAC is printed on the label, for example 68:C6:3A:81:F7:E6. Power-cycle the strip first: it has to dial in before it can be added.

abort.already_configured: This power strip is already configured.
abort.configured_in_yaml: This MAC is declared in your YAML configuration (the plugs list under `phicomm_dc1:`). YAML and the UI cannot manage the same strip at the same time: remove it from YAML and restart Home Assistant before adding it here. Existing entity ids are kept when you do, because both modes share the same unique ids.
abort.invalid_mac: The packet did not carry a usable MAC address.

error.invalid_mac: Not a valid MAC address. Expected 12 hex digits, e.g. 68:C6:3A:81:F7:E6.
error.port_conflict: This host is already listening on port {running_port}; only one service can own that port.
